tooling_notes: First capture run had two defects, both caught by OCR and fixed before beat cutting: (1) the arpeggio beat parsed the prompt symbol 'E + B' as the root name and played the wrong LH pedal, leaving the drill stuck in awaiting-root — re-shot with root parsed from the first token plus a Root-tile cross-check; (2) the tracking beat's midpoint fell on the Chord Drill empty-state tab because the tab click lands ~3.4s into the take — beat6 recut from take6 9-16s so the Root Cycling panel owns its midpoint. Stat-tile digits ('Roots completed' counter) resist OCR at the success-card scroll position; success states were verified via the 'nice — skip to the next root' badge, Next-root button, and per-root prompt symbols (Abm7, Dm7, Bm7) instead. The prior phase's pkill note was heeded: cleanup used a port-scoped kill only. Dev server on :3002 was started inside this session and stopped after capture.
handoff_notes: Chain protocol unchanged for video-progression: own dev-server port >=3002 (:3000 is the opencode proxy, :3001 dead), snapshot config.generated.ts with md5 before regenerating, regenerate IMMEDIATELY before render, count sceneSegments after every regen, re-verify md5 pre-render, --concurrency=2, >=2s segment-fit headroom, tesseract psm 11 + band crops only. The Root Cycling drill reads settings from Convex cloud (mode/quality/root pool) — configure through the UI testids, never by seeding; history seeding key is blocked-drill-rootcycle-log with shape {mode,label,root,quality,ms,ts}.
